decided_by: Codex acting under the user instruction to continue revision work; agent decision, not human review
rationale: All eight matched 1024-token development probe responses reached EOS at 454-744 output tokens; the 256 and 512 caps stopped eight and six responses. Choose 1024 provisionally for six-checkpoint calibration. Choose 2048 as a predeclared doubled budget for sensitivity. Pinned configuration/tokenizer audits show both fit all planned inputs within 4096 positions. Neither the eight responses nor configuration margins establish evaluation-wide adequacy or semantic completeness.

calibration_acceptance_criterion.timing_requirement: A nonempty genuine timed subset within the reviewed calibration IDs; observed effort informs the sampling plan.
calibration_acceptance_criterion.human_budget_review_requirement: No budget truncation identified in the genuinely reviewed development responses; record that assessment and any uncertainty.
calibration_acceptance_criterion.enforcement_scope: Structural archive and human-evidence validators do not certify this scientific acceptance decision. Review stopping summaries and genuine budget-review findings explicitly before freezing the prospective plan.
calibration_acceptance_criterion.passing_interpretation: Operational support for the provisional budget, not a statistical guarantee or proof of semantic answer completeness.

failure_policy: If any calibration cap/unexplained stop or reviewed budget truncation is found, withhold evaluation readiness, preserve the full failed calibration and reason, investigate generation/stopping, and record a new versioned decision and complete matching-cap calibration before reconsideration. Do not mix caps, relabel old responses, selectively omit failures, tune using held-out outcomes, or silently change the estimand. A revised longer cap must still fit every pinned context window.
compute_requirement: Run the exact six-checkpoint calibration in one suitable environment with one recorded execution profile. No model weights are downloaded or model execution started by this decision.
